mapper.select: select su.avatar avatar, kks.name 'createBy', ksc.create_time 'createTime', ksc.text_content 'textContent', ksc.upload_type 'uploadType', ksc.attach_url 'attachUrl' from kg_class_circle ksc join kg_kindergarten_staff kks on kks.uid = ksc.create_by and kks.del_flag = 0 join sys_user su on kks.uid = su.user_id where ksc.kg_id = #{kgId} and ksc.del_flag = 0
